Preserved Primary Document • munce-a1.htm
Angelina Munce was born in Kent Co., DE on
25 November 1843
. She was the daughter of  Robert 	Munce  and his wife, Jemima Hansor.
On
30 July 1863
she married Enoch M. Dean  who was the son of Jesse Dean, Jr. and
Hester Ann Carney.
Photo of Angelina Munce Dean Courtesy of Harry Muncey
Enoch and Angelina moved to Cumberland Co., NJ around
1870
-74 and they appear in the census records living in Fairfield Township, Cumberland Co., NJ. They then moved to 2 Cherry Street, Bridgeton, NJ.
Enoch and Angelina had the following children:
